entries.title: Romans 16:1
segments: I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church in Cenchrea,

entries.title: Romans 16:2
segments: that you receive her in [the] Lord, [as] becomes saints, and that you may assist her in whatever business she has need of you. For she has been a helper of many, and of myself also.

entries.title: Romans 16:3
segments: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my helpers in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Romans 16:4
segments: who have laid down their own necks for my life; to whom not only I give thanks, but also the churches of the nations.

entries.title: Romans 16:5
segments: Likewise [greet] the church that is in their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who is the first-fruits of Achaia to Christ.

entries.title: Romans 16:6
segments: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labor on us.

entries.title: Romans 16:7
segments: Greet Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

entries.title: Romans 16:8
segments: Greet Amplias my beloved in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:9
segments: Greet Urbanus, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

entries.title: Romans 16:10
segments: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of Aristobulus' [household].

entries.title: Romans 16:11
segments: Greet Herodion my kinsman. Greet those who are of the [household] of Narcissus, who are in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:12
segments: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labor in [the] Lord. Greet the beloved Persis, who labored much in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:13
segments: Greet Rufus, chosen in [the] Lord, and his mother and mine.

entries.title: Romans 16:14
segments: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brothers with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:15
segments: Greet Philologus and Julias, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:16
segments: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ greet you.

entries.title: Romans 16:17
segments: And I exhort you, brothers, to watch those making divisions and offenses contrary to the doctrine which you have learned, and avoid them.

entries.title: Romans 16:18
segments: For they who are such do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches [they] deceive the hearts of the simple.

entries.title: Romans 16:19
segments: For your obedience reached to all. Therefore I am glad on your behalf, But I would have you truly wise [as] to good, and simple toward evil.

entries.title: Romans 16:20
segments: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 16:21
segments: Timothy my fellow worker, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater my kinsmen, greet you.

entries.title: Romans 16:22
segments: I, Tertius, who wrote [this] epistle, greet you in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:23
segments: Gaius my host, and the host of me and the whole church, greets you. Erastus the steward of the city greets you, and Quartus a brother.

entries.title: Romans 16:24
segments: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 16:25
segments: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ according to the revelation of [the] mystery, having been unvoiced during eternal times;

entries.title: Romans 16:26
segments: but now has been made plain, and by the prophetic Scriptures, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith;

entries.title: Romans 16:27
segments: to God only wise [be] glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.
